market.question: Next US-Iran senior diplomatic meeting by October 5, 2026?
market.rules:
On September 22, U.S. Special Envoy Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner met Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly in New York, with President Trump saying another meeting is scheduled in the near future.(see: https://www.israelhayom.com/2026/09/22/witkoff-kushner-attended-us-iran-meeting-another-expected-soon). 

This market will resolve to “Yes” if there is a direct or indirect senior-level diplomatic meeting between the United States and Iran by the listed date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

A diplomatic meeting occurs when representatives of both listed countries who are acting in an official capacity and are authorized to engage in diplomacy on behalf of their respective governments or governing authorities deliberately meet for the purpose of diplomacy or negotiation. A qualifying meeting need not result in any agreement, joint statement, or further engagement.

A diplomatic meeting is senior-level if each listed entity is represented by a head of state, a head of government, or a vice president; a foreign minister; a minister of cabinet rank; the secretary or head of a national security council; the presiding officer of a national legislature; a special envoy; or another individual designated by the head of state or head of government to conduct diplomatic negotiations on their behalf. Individuals authorized only for technical, implementation, monitoring, staff-level, preparatory, or working-group-level talks will not be considered designated to conduct diplomatic negotiations on behalf of the head of state or head of government. This definition includes, but is not limited to, all of the following individuals: for the United States, Donald Trump, JD Vance, Marco Rubio, Scott Bessent, Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner; and for Iran, Mojtaba Khamenei, Masoud Pezeshkian, Abbas Araghchi and Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf. In each case, a qualifying representative must participate in the meeting.

A direct meeting refers to a diplomatic meeting where the representatives of both countries directly interact with each other in person. Meetings conducted through translators qualify, provided direct, face-to-face communication occurs. An indirect meeting refers to a meeting conducted indirectly through designated mediators or facilitators. A qualifying indirect meeting must meet both of the following criteria (i) the designated intermediaries act with the knowledge and authorization of both entities; (ii) representatives of both entities are physically present in the same facility, venue, or city as part of a single organized round of talks convened for the purpose of diplomatic engagement, with the intermediary conveying communications between the representatives or delegations on the same day. “The same day” means the same calendar day local time at the meeting location.

Sessions, proceedings, or convenings of standing international organizations, treaty bodies, or recurring multilateral summits or conferences (e.g., the United Nations General Assembly, G7, and G20 summits) do not qualify, unless a qualifying and deliberate diplomatic meeting between representatives of the listed countries is separately held alongside such a convening.

The following do not qualify as either a direct or indirect diplomatic meeting: chance encounters; standalone exchanges limited to greetings, courtesies, or photo opportunities; meetings conducted remotely, by telephone, or by any other means where the relevant representatives are not physically present at the same facility, venue, or city on the same day; discussions involving persons not authorized to engage in diplomacy or negotiation on behalf of their respective governments.

The resolution sources for this market will be official information from the governments of the United States and Iran and a consensus of credible reporting.

This market will resolve to “Yes” if the government of Saudi Arabia announces that the East-West oil pipeline is operational or no longer shut down between market creation and the specified date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

A qualifying announcement must express that the pipeline is presently operating; operation at partial or reduced capacity qualifies.

Announcements that attribute such a claim to third parties, state that the pipeline will or may operate in the future, describe work underway to restore operation, or frame resumption as expected, planned, or conditional, will not qualify.

Once a qualifying announcement is made, this market will resolve to “Yes,” regardless of any subsequent contradictory statements, or alternative information from other sources.

recent_facts.fact: Bloomberg reported that flows through the East-West pipeline to the Red Sea had reached at least 3.5 million b/d after repairs, about half of its 7 million b/d capacity. The report adds that neither the Saudi Energy Ministry nor Saudi Aramco had made any public statement on the pipeline since the attack. The information came from people familiar with the matter.

The article's timeline gives the restart on September 22, 2026 at minimal capacity, citing unnamed Reuters sources, and says full recovery could take 6 to 8 weeks. It cites no Ministry of Energy, Saudi Press Agency (SPA) or Energy Minister statement about the restart.

Three unnamed sources said Saudi Arabia had restarted the East-West Pipeline, which was pumping at a low rate, and that exports from Yanbu could resume. Aramco did not comment, and a security source said a full resumption could take weeks. Before the shutdown the line carried about 4 million b/d.
Bloomberg reported that Saudi Aramco was running tests and building pressure on the East-West pipeline with the aim of restoring significant flows by the end of that week.

Reuters reported that Saudi Arabia had resumed crude loadings at Yanbu after the pipeline restart, averaging about 2 million b/d since the previous week. The report is based on sources and tracking data, not an official government statement.

The Ministry of Energy announced that the East-West Pipeline had been shut down as a precaution after multiple attacks on the morning of September 10 in the Riyadh and Madinah regions. This is the official announcement the question refers to.
US Energy Secretary Chris Wright called the Saudi pipeline closure a brief interruption that would last days. This is a US official's statement, not a Saudi government one.

After attacks on a pumping station in April 2026 cut East-West throughput by 700,000 b/d, the Saudi Ministry of Energy issued a public SPA statement on April 12, 2026 that full pumping capacity of about 7 million b/d had been restored. This shows the ministry has formally announced a pipeline restoration before.

Only an official Saudi government announcement that the pipeline is currently operating (partial capacity counts) qualifies. Media reports citing unnamed sources, Aramco tests, or tanker-tracking data showing flows do not count unless the government itself says the pipeline is operating.
The window for a qualifying Saudi government announcement closes October 15, 2026 at 11:59 PM ET. As of September 28 reporting, no official statement on the restart had been found.

market.question: US announces end of Iranian blockade by October 15, 2026?
market.rules:
On July 13, 2026, Trump announced the United States would reinstate its naval blockade of Iran, targeting Iranian ships and customers.

This market will resolve to “Yes” if the United States government, or an authorized representative of the United States government, publicly and officially announces the end, termination, lifting, or suspension of the United States’ naval blockade on Iranian ships and ships of Iranian customers, between market creation and the specified date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

An announcement qualifies if it communicates that the United States will generally cease blocking vessel traffic for Iranian ships and customers, including an announcement that the blockade will not take effect at all, even if some restrictions remain (for example, an imposition of fees). An announcement does not qualify if it reflects only a limited or partial change that stops short of a general end or suspension of the blockade, for example, an exemption for a specific vessel, cargo, or port.

A qualifying announcement must be a declarative statement of the United States government’s present termination or suspension of the blockade, previously-unannounced prior termination or suspension of the blockade, or definitive decision to terminate or suspend the blockade.

A qualifying announcement must clearly and unambiguously identify the end or suspension of the blockade. Statements that merely allude to, reference, or describe an end to the blockade, without clearly communicating it, do not qualify. The announcement need not use specific terminology or reference the end of a blockade by name; an announcement of a resumption of prior obligations, the maintenance of a status quo, or a return to a previously agreed baseline qualifies, provided the substantive policy of ending or suspending the blockade is clearly and unambiguously communicated.

A qualifying announcement must be made through official channels, by an individual acting in an official capacity. Statements made incidentally or informally in a context not intended for official communication do not qualify.

The following do not qualify:

Anonymous, unattributed, or leaked statements not confirmed as official;
Statements by persons not authorized to speak for the United States government;
Third-party speculation, analysis, or predictions that the United States government will announce or implement an end to the blockade;
Satirical, fabricated, hacked, or impersonated communications; and
Statements that describe a prospective, contingent, probable, or conditional end to the blockade rather than announcing a present and decided position.

Once a qualifying announcement is made, this market will resolve to “Yes” regardless of whether it is later reversed, or whether the blockade actually ends in practice.

Resolution will be based on official information from the United States government, including the President, the Department of Defense, the Department of State, and United States Central Command (CENTCOM), or the official representatives of the United States government.

recent_facts.source: Wikipedia (2026 United States naval blockade of Iran)
recent_facts.fact: The reimposed US naval blockade of Iranian ports began July 14, 2026, after Trump announced it on July 13. The article says it is still in effect, with no end date announced.
Trump publicly rejected Iran's proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, saying "They made a proposal but I rejected it." Iran's price for reopening included an end to the US naval blockade.

Iran's plan would reopen Hormuz within 7 days if the US lifts the blockade, waives sanctions, releases $12bn in frozen assets and agrees to a regional ceasefire that includes Lebanon. The US wants all issues, including nuclear, settled together rather than step by step. Araghchi said Iran's position has not changed, and no formal next meeting has been announced.

On September 30, Iran was reported to have received Washington's response to its seven-point proposal through Qatari mediators. The main dispute is said to be the order of steps in the 7-day framework, and the White House is reported to be tempering expectations of an imminent breakthrough.
Reports said Trump expects to resume bombing Iran after the early-November US midterm elections. Officials said he has not made an irrevocable decision to restart major combat.

Trump posted on Truth Social "I offered them NOTHING!" A US official said sanctions relief is possible if there is concrete progress on nuclear issues, but the two sides disagree on timing. The US also imposed new sanctions on Iranian military suppliers.
Axios reported that Trump is willing to ease sanctions and unfreeze assets in exchange for nuclear concessions from Iran. The full article could not be accessed.

Precedent: the first blockade (April 13 to June 18) ended when Trump announced a deal on June 14, signed an MOU on June 17, and CENTCOM formally announced the blockade's removal on June 18. It lasted about 2 months, and the lifting came only as part of a signed war-ending agreement.
By September 12, CENTCOM said it had redirected more than 100 vessels. The WSJ reported in early September that the blockade had halted new Iranian oil exports from the Persian Gulf.

On September 5, the IRGC fired ballistic missiles at a US carrier and a destroyer enforcing the blockade; CENTCOM said neither was hit. Iran threatened more severe attacks if the blockade continues and on September 6 announced a "restricted zone" running south of Hormuz.

No formal US-Iran negotiating session is scheduled before the October 15 deadline. Indirect talks run through Qatar, and the US midterms, which Trump has linked to the timing of a deal, fall in early November, after the question closes.

For the purpose of this market, the “margin of victory” is defined as the absolute difference between the percentages of valid votes received by the first- and second-place candidates. Percentages of the valid votes received by each candidate will be determined by dividing the total number of valid votes each of the top two candidates receives by the sum of all valid votes cast in the election.

Denmark host Portugal in the UEFA Nations League (League A, Group 4, matchday 3) on Thursday 2026-10-01 at 20:45 CEST (18:45 UTC). The venue is Parken in Copenhagen, which holds 38,190, so Portugal are the away side.

Portugal coach Jorge Jesus said he is confident Bruno Fernandes will recover in time for Denmark, and the plan is for him to return straight away.

Cristiano Ronaldo was an unused substitute in the win in Oslo. It was the first time that had happened in a competitive international since 2008.

market.question: Will the unemployment rate (U-3) be above 3.9% in September? (Above 3.9%)
market.rules: If the seasonally adjusted unemployment rate (U-3) reported by the Bureau of Labor Statistics in the Employment Situation Report is above 3.9% in September 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.

recent_facts.source: Bureau of Labor Statistics, Employment Situation Summary (August 2026)
recent_facts.fact: The seasonally adjusted U-3 unemployment rate was unchanged at 4.1% in August 2026, with 7.0 million people unemployed. For the September figure to be 3.9% or lower, the rate would have to fall by at least 0.2 percentage points in one month.

Nonfarm payrolls rose 162,000 in August 2026, compared with an average gain of 31,000 a month over the prior 12 months. Unemployment rates were 4.0% for adult men, 3.5% for adult women and 14.1% for teenagers.
Labor force participation edged up to 61.6% in August 2026, still below January's level. June and July payrolls were revised up by a combined 55,000.

The unemployment rate fell from 4.2% in June to 4.1% in July 2026 even though payrolls fell by 23,000. The drop came mainly from people leaving the labor force: participation fell to 61.4%, its lowest in more than five years.
Bloomberg described 4.1% as a one-year low for the unemployment rate, meaning the rate has not been below 4.1% at any point in the past year.
Initial jobless claims were 197,000 for the week ending September 19, 2026, down from 198,000 the week before. Continuing claims fell to 1.719 million.
Jobless claims fell to 196,000 during the holiday week, which included the September CPS survey reference week around September 12. Continuing claims also dropped.
The September 2026 Employment Situation report is scheduled for Friday, October 2, 2026, at 8:30 a.m. ET (12:30 UTC). The question closes one minute earlier, at 12:29 UTC.

The House passed a continuing resolution 370-48, and the Senate had earlier passed it 90-6. It funds the government through December 11, 2026, and was signed into law, so there is no shutdown on October 1 to delay the BLS release (unlike the October 2025 shutdown, which cancelled the October 2025 household survey).
BLS publishes U-3 rounded to one decimal place, from the household survey (CPS). 'Above 3.9%' therefore resolves Yes if the published September rate is 4.0% or higher.

The FED interest rates are defined in this market by the upper bound of the target federal funds range. The decisions on the target federal funds range are made by the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meetings.

The resolution source for this market is the FOMC’s statement after its meeting scheduled for October 27-28, 2026 according to the official calendar: https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm.

This market may resolve as soon as the FOMC’s statement for their October meeting with relevant data is issued. If no statement is released by the end date of the next scheduled meeting, this market will resolve to the "No change" bracket.

market.question: Will Yashar win the most seats in the 2026 Israeli legislative election?
market.rules:
Legislative elections are expected to be held in Israel on October 27, 2026.

This market will resolve according to the political party or coalition that wins the greatest number of seats in the Israeli Knesset as a result of this election.

If the results of this election are not definitively known by June 30, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".

In the event of a tie between multiple parties or coalitions for the most seats won, this market will resolve in favor of the party or coalition whose candidate list received a greater number of valid votes. In the event that results in a tie, this market will resolve in favor of the party whose listed name appears first in alphabetical order.

This market's resolution will be based solely on the number of seats won by the named party or coalition in the Israeli Knesset.

This market will resolve based on the election results, as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as reported by Israel’s Central Election Committee (Va'adet HaBehirot HaMerkazit) (https://www.gov.il/en/departments/central-elections-committee/govil-landing-page).

The following rules govern the merging, joint contention, and splitting of listed parties:

- If Likud or Together (or any successor party created through a merger) merge with or contest the election jointly with any other party, the option corresponding to Likud or Together will represent the resultant candidate list or merged party. 

Otherwise:

- If a listed party merges with, or contests the election as part of a joint candidate list with, one or more unlisted parties prior to the election, the option corresponding to the listed party will represent all seats won by the merged party or joint candidate list. If a listed party merges with, or contests the election as part of a joint candidate list with, one or more other listed parties prior to the election, the option corresponding to the party which held the most seats in the prior Knesset will represent all seats won by the merged party/joint candidate list. If these rules do not adequately determine which option represents a merged party or joint candidate list, the listed party whose name, as listed in this market, comes first in alphabetical order, will represent all seats won by the merged party or joint candidate list.

- If a listed party splits into multiple parties prior to the election, the option corresponding to the listed party will represent the resulting party that holds the greatest number of seats in the Israeli Knesset as a result of the split. If these rules do not adequately determine which party represents a listed option after a split, the listed option will represent all seats won by the party resulting from the split whose primary English name comes first in alphabetical order.

market.question: Saudi Oil Pipeline (East-West) restarts by October 15?
market.rules:
On September 11, 2026, Saudi Arabia's Ministry of Energy announced that the East-West oil pipeline has been shut down.

This market will resolve to “Yes” if the government of Saudi Arabia announces that the East-West oil pipeline is operational or no longer shut down between market creation and the specified date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

A qualifying announcement must express that the pipeline is presently operating; operation at partial or reduced capacity qualifies.

Announcements that attribute such a claim to third parties, state that the pipeline will or may operate in the future, describe work underway to restore operation, or frame resumption as expected, planned, or conditional, will not qualify.

Once a qualifying announcement is made, this market will resolve to “Yes,” regardless of any subsequent contradictory statements, or alternative information from other sources.

The resolution source for this market will be official information from the government of Saudi Arabia.

recent_facts.fact: Bloomberg reported that flows through the East-West pipeline to the Red Sea had reached at least 3.5 million b/d after repairs, about half of its 7 million b/d capacity. The report adds that neither the Saudi Energy Ministry nor Saudi Aramco had made any public statement on the pipeline since the attack. The information came from people familiar with the matter.

The article's timeline gives the restart on September 22, 2026 at minimal capacity, citing unnamed Reuters sources, and says full recovery could take 6 to 8 weeks. It cites no Ministry of Energy, Saudi Press Agency (SPA) or Energy Minister statement about the restart.

Three unnamed sources said Saudi Arabia had restarted the East-West Pipeline, which was pumping at a low rate, and that exports from Yanbu could resume. Aramco did not comment, and a security source said a full resumption could take weeks. Before the shutdown the line carried about 4 million b/d.
Bloomberg reported that Saudi Aramco was running tests and building pressure on the East-West pipeline with the aim of restoring significant flows by the end of that week.

Reuters reported that Saudi Arabia had resumed crude loadings at Yanbu after the pipeline restart, averaging about 2 million b/d since the previous week. The report is based on sources and tracking data, not an official government statement.

The Ministry of Energy announced that the East-West Pipeline had been shut down as a precaution after multiple attacks on the morning of September 10 in the Riyadh and Madinah regions. This is the official announcement the question refers to.
US Energy Secretary Chris Wright called the Saudi pipeline closure a brief interruption that would last days. This is a US official's statement, not a Saudi government one.

After attacks on a pumping station in April 2026 cut East-West throughput by 700,000 b/d, the Saudi Ministry of Energy issued a public SPA statement on April 12, 2026 that full pumping capacity of about 7 million b/d had been restored. This shows the ministry has formally announced a pipeline restoration before.

Only an official Saudi government announcement that the pipeline is currently operating (partial capacity counts) qualifies. Media reports citing unnamed sources, Aramco tests, or tanker-tracking data showing flows do not count unless the government itself says the pipeline is operating.
The window for a qualifying Saudi government announcement closes October 15, 2026 at 11:59 PM ET. As of September 28 reporting, no official statement on the restart had been found.

market.question: Will the ECB announce no change at the October 2026 meeting?

This market will resolve according to the change in basis points in the deposit facility rate resulting from the October 2026 meeting of the European Central Bank, relative to the level it was prior to this meeting.

The resolution source will be official information from the European Central Bank, including the statement or release from its October 2026 meeting, scheduled for October 28-29, 2026, as listed on the official European Central Bank calendar (https://www.ecb.europa.eu/press/calendars/mgcgc/html/index.en.html). If the specified rate is defined by an upper and lower bound, the relevant change will be the change to the upper bound.

If the specified rate is changed to a level not expressed in the displayed options, the change will be rounded according to the following guidelines. Increases or decreases of less than 25 bps will be rounded to 25 bps (e.g. an increase or decrease of 10 bps would be considered to be an increase or decrease of 25 bps). Increases or decreases of greater than 25 bps will be rounded to the nearest 25 bps and will be rounded away from 0 in cases of equidistance (e.g., an increase or decrease of 37.5 bps would be considered to be an increase or decrease of 50 bps). Displayed options of “Increase” or “Decrease” will include policy rate increases or decreases of any size.

If the specified meeting is postponed to a date and time before the start of the next scheduled meeting, this market will resolve based on the outcome of that postponed meeting. If the specified meeting is cancelled, or postponed such that no decision is announced by the start of the next scheduled meeting, this market will resolve to the “No Change” bracket. Emergency changes to the specified rate not resulting from the specified meeting will not be considered.

market.question: US announces end of Iranian blockade by October 15, 2026?
market.rules:
On July 13, 2026, Trump announced the United States would reinstate its naval blockade of Iran, targeting Iranian ships and customers.

This market will resolve to “Yes” if the United States government, or an authorized representative of the United States government, publicly and officially announces the end, termination, lifting, or suspension of the United States’ naval blockade on Iranian ships and ships of Iranian customers, between market creation and the specified date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

An announcement qualifies if it communicates that the United States will generally cease blocking vessel traffic for Iranian ships and customers, including an announcement that the blockade will not take effect at all, even if some restrictions remain (for example, an imposition of fees). An announcement does not qualify if it reflects only a limited or partial change that stops short of a general end or suspension of the blockade, for example, an exemption for a specific vessel, cargo, or port.

A qualifying announcement must be a declarative statement of the United States government’s present termination or suspension of the blockade, previously-unannounced prior termination or suspension of the blockade, or definitive decision to terminate or suspend the blockade.

A qualifying announcement must clearly and unambiguously identify the end or suspension of the blockade. Statements that merely allude to, reference, or describe an end to the blockade, without clearly communicating it, do not qualify. The announcement need not use specific terminology or reference the end of a blockade by name; an announcement of a resumption of prior obligations, the maintenance of a status quo, or a return to a previously agreed baseline qualifies, provided the substantive policy of ending or suspending the blockade is clearly and unambiguously communicated.

A qualifying announcement must be made through official channels, by an individual acting in an official capacity. Statements made incidentally or informally in a context not intended for official communication do not qualify.

The following do not qualify:

Anonymous, unattributed, or leaked statements not confirmed as official;
Statements by persons not authorized to speak for the United States government;
Third-party speculation, analysis, or predictions that the United States government will announce or implement an end to the blockade;
Satirical, fabricated, hacked, or impersonated communications; and
Statements that describe a prospective, contingent, probable, or conditional end to the blockade rather than announcing a present and decided position.

Once a qualifying announcement is made, this market will resolve to “Yes” regardless of whether it is later reversed, or whether the blockade actually ends in practice.

Resolution will be based on official information from the United States government, including the President, the Department of Defense, the Department of State, and United States Central Command (CENTCOM), or the official representatives of the United States government.

recent_facts.source: Wikipedia (2026 United States naval blockade of Iran)
recent_facts.fact: The reimposed US naval blockade of Iranian ports began July 14, 2026, after Trump announced it on July 13. The article says it is still in effect, with no end date announced.
Trump publicly rejected Iran's proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, saying "They made a proposal but I rejected it." Iran's price for reopening included an end to the US naval blockade.

Iran's plan would reopen Hormuz within 7 days if the US lifts the blockade, waives sanctions, releases $12bn in frozen assets and agrees to a regional ceasefire that includes Lebanon. The US wants all issues, including nuclear, settled together rather than step by step. Araghchi said Iran's position has not changed, and no formal next meeting has been announced.

On September 30, Iran was reported to have received Washington's response to its seven-point proposal through Qatari mediators. The main dispute is said to be the order of steps in the 7-day framework, and the White House is reported to be tempering expectations of an imminent breakthrough.
Reports said Trump expects to resume bombing Iran after the early-November US midterm elections. Officials said he has not made an irrevocable decision to restart major combat.

Trump posted on Truth Social "I offered them NOTHING!" A US official said sanctions relief is possible if there is concrete progress on nuclear issues, but the two sides disagree on timing. The US also imposed new sanctions on Iranian military suppliers.
Axios reported that Trump is willing to ease sanctions and unfreeze assets in exchange for nuclear concessions from Iran. The full article could not be accessed.

Precedent: the first blockade (April 13 to June 18) ended when Trump announced a deal on June 14, signed an MOU on June 17, and CENTCOM formally announced the blockade's removal on June 18. It lasted about 2 months, and the lifting came only as part of a signed war-ending agreement.
By September 12, CENTCOM said it had redirected more than 100 vessels. The WSJ reported in early September that the blockade had halted new Iranian oil exports from the Persian Gulf.

On September 5, the IRGC fired ballistic missiles at a US carrier and a destroyer enforcing the blockade; CENTCOM said neither was hit. Iran threatened more severe attacks if the blockade continues and on September 6 announced a "restricted zone" running south of Hormuz.

No formal US-Iran negotiating session is scheduled before the October 15 deadline. Indirect talks run through Qatar, and the US midterms, which Trump has linked to the timing of a deal, fall in early November, after the question closes.

market.question: Will Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva win the first round of the 2026 Brazilian presidential election by 5–10%?
market.rules:
A presidential election is scheduled to take place in Brazil on October 4, 2026.

This market will resolve according to the margin of victory between the top two candidates in the first round of the next Brazil Presidential Election.

For the purpose of this market, the “margin of victory” is defined as the absolute difference between the percentages of valid votes received by the first- and second-place candidates. Percentages of the valid votes received by each candidate will be determined by dividing the total number of valid votes each of the top two candidates receives by the sum of all valid votes cast in the election.

If the reported value falls exactly between two brackets, then this market will resolve to the higher range bracket.

This market will resolve based on the official vote count once the vote count has been made official.

If a recount is initiated before the vote total has been made official, the market will remain open until the recount is completed and the vote is made official.

If the result of this election isn't known definitively by June 30, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, the market will resolve to "Other".

This market will resolve based on the result of the election, as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as reported by the Brazilian government, specifically the Superior Electoral Court (Tribunal Superior Eleitoral, TSE) (e.g., https://dadosabertos.tse.jus.br/).

recent_facts.fact: The Atlas-Bloomberg poll released Sept 29, five days before the vote, had Lula at 46.2% of valid first-round votes and Flávio Bolsonaro at 43.1%. That is a 3.1-point gap, with a margin of error of 1 point.

The Quaest poll released Sept 28 (fieldwork Sept 24–27, 2,004 voters) had Lula at 45.9% of valid votes and Flávio Bolsonaro at 40%, a gap of about 5.9 points. In total votes the figures were 39% to 34%.

The BTG/Nexus poll (Sept 25–27, 2,000 voters) had Lula at 42% and Flávio Bolsonaro at 37% of total first-round votes, with Caiado and Cury at 5% each. That is a 5-point gap in total votes. The earlier BTG/Nexus poll, released Sept 21, had 40% to 37%.

PoderData (Sept 20–23, 3,000 interviews, margin of error 1.8 points) had Lula at 43% and Flávio at 42% of valid votes, Cury at 6%, Renan Santos at 3% and Caiado at 2%. PoderData's Sept 13–16 poll had 37% to 36%.

Datafolha's early-September poll had Lula at 38%, Flávio Bolsonaro at 32%, Augusto Cury at 7%, and Renan Santos and Ronaldo Caiado at 4% each in the prompted first-round scenario. These look like total-vote shares, a 6-point gap. The simulated runoff was 46% to 44%.
Al Jazeera reported on Sept 25 that a new poll showed Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro still essentially tied.
A September Veritá poll showed Flávio Bolsonaro leading Lula in both the first round and the runoff.
In Quaest's weekly tracking, blank and spoiled ballot intentions rose from 7% to 10%. Pollsters agree Lula leads the first round but differ on the size of the gap.

The main candidates are Lula (PT), Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), Ronaldo Caiado (PSD), Romeu Zema (Novo) and Augusto Cury (Avante), plus six minor candidates. The campaign was affected by the Banco Master and INSS fraud scandals and by a crisis at the Supreme Court from Sept 1 to 23.
The first round is on Oct 4, 2026, and a runoff, if needed, is on Oct 25. The TSE publishes valid-vote percentages on election night.

In the 2022 first round, Lula won 48.43% of valid votes to Jair Bolsonaro's 43.20%, a 5.23-point margin. Final polls had shown a much larger Lula lead: Datafolha's last poll had about 50% to 36% in valid votes, so Bolsonaro was underestimated by several points.
In the 2018 first round, Jair Bolsonaro won 46.03% of valid votes to Fernando Haddad's 29.28%. His vote came in above the final polls.

market.question: Will Aleksandar Vučić be the next Prime Minister of Serbia?
market.rules:
This market will resolve to the next individual who officially assumes the office of Prime Minister of Serbia by June 30, 2028, 11:59 PM ET.

To count for resolution, the individual must be elected by the National Assembly and be formally sworn-in, resulting in the official formation of a new government. Any interim or caretaker Prime Minister who is not elected by the National Assembly will not count toward the resolution of this market.

If no such Prime Minister takes office by June 30, 2028, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to “Other”.

This market will resolve based on a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve solely based on official information from the Serbian government.

recent_facts.fact: Aleksandar Vučić resigned as President of Serbia so he can run for Prime Minister in the snap parliamentary election. The Serbian Progressive Party (SNS) nominated him as its candidate for Prime Minister.

The constitution bars Vučić from a third presidential term. He resigned to lead the SNS in the 25 October vote. Ana Brnabić, the outgoing parliament speaker and a close ally, becomes acting president.
On 9 September 2026 Vučić dissolved the National Assembly and called early parliamentary elections for 25 October 2026. Regular elections had not been due until December 2027.

Vučić heads the SNS-led 'United Serbia' list, ahead of Miloš Vučević and Ana Brnabić. The other main lists are the Student List 'Students Are Winning', Ivica Dačić's SPS-led 'Factor of Stability', European Serbia and the Authentic Right. The sitting Prime Minister is Đuro Macut, who took office on 16 April 2025.
NSPM's September poll, fielded in early September, puts the Student List at 44.4% and Vučić's United Serbia at 41.7%. NSPM's July poll had them at 39.6% and 37.5%.

A Faktor Plus poll fielded 16–20 September puts Vučić's list at 48.6% and the Student List at 37.1%, with SPS at 4.9% and European Serbia at 3.6%. Since Faktor Plus's previous poll, Vučić's list rose 1.4 points and the Student List rose 5.6 points.
The NSPM September survey was taken before the 'Narodna Srbija' coalition withdrew from the election in favour of the Student List.

The student movement has formally registered its election list and moved from street protests to campaigning. Analysts quoted say election day itself will probably be highly contentious and raise concerns about irregularities.

After the 17 December 2023 election, the new government under Vučević was elected on 2 May 2024, about 4.5 months after the vote. After the 3 April 2022 election, Brnabić's third cabinet took office on 26 October 2022, about 6.7 months after the vote.

The question counts only a Prime Minister elected by the National Assembly and sworn in. Macut's cabinet continuing in office, or any caretaker, does not count. After the 25 October vote, a new government must be formed through a nomination and an Assembly vote, and past formations have taken several months.

market.question: Will the ECB announce a 25 bps increase at the October 2026 meeting?
market.rules:
This market will resolve according to the change in basis points in the deposit facility rate resulting from the October 2026 meeting of the European Central Bank, relative to the level it was prior to this meeting.

The resolution source will be official information from the European Central Bank, including the statement or release from its October 2026 meeting, scheduled for October 28-29, 2026, as listed on the official European Central Bank calendar (https://www.ecb.europa.eu/press/calendars/mgcgc/html/index.en.html). This market may resolve as soon as the statement or release of the European Central Bank's October 2026 meeting with relevant data is issued.

If the specified rate is defined by an upper and lower bound, the relevant change will be the change to the upper bound.

If the specified rate is changed to a level not expressed in the displayed options, the change will be rounded according to the following guidelines. Increases or decreases of less than 25 bps will be rounded to 25 bps (e.g. an increase or decrease of 10 bps would be considered to be an increase or decrease of 25 bps). Increases or decreases of greater than 25 bps will be rounded to the nearest 25 bps and will be rounded away from 0 in cases of equidistance (e.g., an increase or decrease of 37.5 bps would be considered to be an increase or decrease of 50 bps). Displayed options of “Increase” or “Decrease” will include policy rate increases or decreases of any size.

If the specified meeting is postponed to a date and time before the start of the next scheduled meeting, this market will resolve based on the outcome of that postponed meeting. If the specified meeting is cancelled, or postponed such that no decision is announced by the start of the next scheduled meeting, this market will resolve to the “No Change” bracket. Emergency changes to the specified rate not resulting from the specified meeting will not be considered.

Each 10 rushing yards increase the payout by the following schedule: 0–9 yards, $0.0000; 10–19, $0.0001; 20–29, $0.0010; 30–39, $0.0033; 40–49, $0.0080; 50–59, $0.0156; 60–69, $0.0270; 70–79, $0.0428; 80–89, $0.0640; 90–99, $0.0911; 100–109, $0.1250; 110–119, $0.1663; 120–129, $0.2160; 130–139, $0.2746; 140–149, $0.3430; 150–159, $0.4218; 160–169, $0.5120; 170–179, $0.6141; 180–189, $0.7290; 190–199, $0.8573; and 200 or more, $1.0000. Each No contract pays $1.00 minus the Yes payout. Yes pays out at most $1.00. Then the market resolves to Yes.
This is a scalar market. The Yes payout per contract shown above follows this calculation:
Payout Formula = floor(10000 x (y / 200)^3) / 10000
y = min(200, max(0, 10 x floor(s / 10)))
s = official rushing yards

The No payout is $1.00 minus the Yes payout. Negative rushing yard totals pay Yes $0.00.

The event is a pro-am, with each team made up of one amateur and one professional, played across three courses. After 54 holes the top 60 professionals and the leading 20 pro-am teams advance to the final round at St Andrews. Under the market rules, a Hatton withdrawal or non-start before teeing off resolves No.

Hatton has won this event three times (2016, 2017, 2024). In 2017 and 2024 he posted the tournament-record 264 (−24), and his 2024 win was by one stroke over Nicolas Colsaerts. He is the only player to have successfully defended the title.
In 2025 Robert MacIntyre won at 198 (−18), finishing four strokes ahead of runner-up Tyrrell Hatton. That means Hatton won or finished second in each of the last two editions.
Hatton tied for 27th at the BMW PGA Championship (September 17–20), shooting 70-70-71-67 (278, −10). Alex Noren successfully defended his BMW PGA title.
Hatton missed the cut at the Amgen Irish Open (September 10–13) with rounds of 78-70 (148, +8).

Hatton is playing seven DP World Tour events between LIV Golf's final event in Indianapolis and the DP World Tour's season-ending playoffs, and the Dunhill Links is the fourth of them. He says others are working on his LIV future after Saudi Arabia's PIF withdrew its funding, while he concentrates on the DP World Tour.
Hatton finished tied 3rd at the 2026 Masters, the best major finish of his career.
Hatton finished tied 7th at the 2026 U.S. Open, which earned him an exemption into the 2027 U.S. Open.
26 LIV golfers are entered for the 2026 Dunhill Links, which adds depth to a field that also includes top DP World Tour players such as Fitzpatrick, Fleetwood, Rose and MacIntyre.

recent_facts.fact: UFC 332 is set for October 3, 2026 at the Delta Center in Salt Lake City, with Natália Silva vs. Wang Cong for the vacant UFC Women's Flyweight Championship as the headliner. No withdrawal or change to the main event is listed. The only late change mentioned is on the undercard: bantamweight Bernardo Sopaj pulled out with an injury and Anthony Romero replaced him.

The main event was first booked as Valentina Shevchenko defending the title against Natália Silva. Shevchenko withdrew with a ligament injury to her back and shoulder that is expected to keep her out for a year, so the title was vacated and Wang Cong stepped in to face Silva.

Silva is 20-5-1, the No. 1-ranked women's flyweight contender, and has won 14 fights in a row. She is 8-0 in the UFC since 2022, and her last three wins came against former champions Jessica Andrade, Alexa Grasso and Rose Namajunas.
Wang is 10-1 and ranked in the top 10. She has won four straight since the only loss of her pro career, to Gabriella Fernandes in 2024. She also beat Valentina Shevchenko in a 2015 kickboxing match.

In her last fight, at UFC 329 on 2026-07-11, Wang beat Tracy Cortez by unanimous decision, 29-27 on all three cards. She won despite a one-point deduction for an illegal knee to the head. That bout was at flyweight.

Wang started 1-1 in the UFC before her four straight wins, and two of those four wins came at catchweight rather than flyweight. For example, her February 7, 2026 fight with Eduarda Moura was at a 127.5 lb catchweight after both fighters missed weight (per UFCalendar). Weight-cut history is relevant at a title weigh-in, but the market resolves only on who wins the fight.

UFC says Wang has the highest striking differential in the women's flyweight division and is the most accurate striker in the division's history. It describes Silva as a fast, kick-heavy striker with strong footwork. Both fighters lean on striking.

The title fight is scheduled for five rounds and will be held at altitude in Salt Lake City. Neither fighter has headlined a UFC event before, and as far as these sources show, neither has fought a five-round UFC bout.

In fight-week interviews, Wang called Silva the toughest opponent she has faced in the UFC and praised her distance management and kicking. Neither this coverage nor any other found reports an injury for either fighter.
Wang's amateur background includes gold medals at the 2013 World Wushu Championships and the 2014 Asian Games, plus a silver in amateur boxing at the 2019 World Championships. Her UFC record is 5-1.

The 14-fight card runs Saturday, October 3: early prelims at 4 PM ET, prelims at 6 PM ET, and the main card at 8 PM ET on CBS and Paramount+. Official weigh-ins are normally held the day before the event.

The market resolves Yes only if Wang Cong wins. A draw or no contest pays 50/50. If the fight is postponed by up to two weeks, the market stays open until the rescheduled fight. If it is cancelled or moved more than two weeks out, the market resolves at a fair price.

market.rules:
A presidential election is scheduled to take place in Brazil on October 4, 2026.

This market will resolve according to the listed candidate who receives the third-most valid votes in the first round of this election.

The named candidates will be primarily ranked by the number of valid votes received in the specified election. If two or more candidates are tied on valid votes, ties will be broken by alphabetical order of the candidates' last names. This market will resolve to the candidate that occupies the third-highest finishing position after applying this ranking.

If the result of this election isn't known definitively by June 30, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, the market will resolve to "Other".

This market will resolve based on the result of the election, as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as reported by the Brazilian government, specifically the Superior Electoral Court (Tribunal Superior Eleitoral, TSE) (e.g., https://dadosabertos.tse.jus.br/).

market.rules:
The FED interest rates are defined in this market by the upper bound of the target federal funds range. The decisions on the target federal funds range are made by the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meetings.

This market will resolve to the amount of basis points the upper bound of the target federal funds rate is changed by versus the level it was prior to the Federal Reserve's October 2026 meeting.

This market may resolve as soon as the FOMC’s statement for their October meeting with relevant data is issued. If no statement is released by the end date of the next scheduled meeting, this market will resolve to the "No change" bracket.

market.question: Will Flávio Bolsonaro win 39% or more of the valid vote in the first round of the 2026 Brazilian presidential election?
market.rules:
A presidential election is scheduled to take place in Brazil on October 4, 2026.

This market will resolve according to the percentage of valid votes received by Flávio Bolsonaro in the first round of this election.

The percentage of valid votes received by the specified candidate will be determined by dividing the total number of valid votes the candidate receives in the first round by the sum of all valid votes cast in the first round.

If the reported value falls exactly between two brackets, then this market will resolve to the higher range bracket.

If the specified candidate does not appear on the ballot in the first round, or otherwise receives no valid votes, this market will resolve to the lowest range bracket.

This market will resolve based on the official vote count.

If a recount is initiated before the vote total has been made official, the market will remain open until the recount is completed and the vote is made official.

If the result of this election isn't known definitively by June 30, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to the lowest range bracket.

This market will resolve based on the result of the election, as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as reported by the Brazilian government, including the Superior Electoral Court (Tribunal Superior Eleitoral, TSE) (e.g., https://dadosabertos.tse.jus.br/).

market.question: Will the unemployment rate (U-3) be above 3.9% in September? (Above 3.9%)
market.rules: If the seasonally adjusted unemployment rate (U-3) reported by the Bureau of Labor Statistics in the Employment Situation Report is above 3.9% in September 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.

recent_facts.source: Bureau of Labor Statistics, Employment Situation Summary (August 2026)
recent_facts.fact: The seasonally adjusted U-3 unemployment rate was unchanged at 4.1% in August 2026, with 7.0 million people unemployed. For the September figure to be 3.9% or lower, the rate would have to fall by at least 0.2 percentage points in one month.

Nonfarm payrolls rose 162,000 in August 2026, compared with an average gain of 31,000 a month over the prior 12 months. Unemployment rates were 4.0% for adult men, 3.5% for adult women and 14.1% for teenagers.
Labor force participation edged up to 61.6% in August 2026, still below January's level. June and July payrolls were revised up by a combined 55,000.

The unemployment rate fell from 4.2% in June to 4.1% in July 2026 even though payrolls fell by 23,000. The drop came mainly from people leaving the labor force: participation fell to 61.4%, its lowest in more than five years.
Bloomberg described 4.1% as a one-year low for the unemployment rate, meaning the rate has not been below 4.1% at any point in the past year.
Initial jobless claims were 197,000 for the week ending September 19, 2026, down from 198,000 the week before. Continuing claims fell to 1.719 million.
Jobless claims fell to 196,000 during the holiday week, which included the September CPS survey reference week around September 12. Continuing claims also dropped.
The September 2026 Employment Situation report is scheduled for Friday, October 2, 2026, at 8:30 a.m. ET (12:30 UTC). The question closes one minute earlier, at 12:29 UTC.

The House passed a continuing resolution 370-48, and the Senate had earlier passed it 90-6. It funds the government through December 11, 2026, and was signed into law, so there is no shutdown on October 1 to delay the BLS release (unlike the October 2025 shutdown, which cancelled the October 2025 household survey).
BLS publishes U-3 rounded to one decimal place, from the household survey (CPS). 'Above 3.9%' therefore resolves Yes if the published September rate is 4.0% or higher.

market.question: Will Yashar win the most seats in the 2026 Israeli legislative election?
market.rules:
Legislative elections are expected to be held in Israel on October 27, 2026.

This market will resolve according to the political party or coalition that wins the greatest number of seats in the Israeli Knesset as a result of this election.

If the results of this election are not definitively known by June 30, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".

In the event of a tie between multiple parties or coalitions for the most seats won, this market will resolve in favor of the party or coalition whose candidate list received a greater number of valid votes. In the event that results in a tie, this market will resolve in favor of the party whose listed name appears first in alphabetical order.

This market's resolution will be based solely on the number of seats won by the named party or coalition in the Israeli Knesset.

This market will resolve based on the election results, as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as reported by Israel’s Central Election Committee (Va'adet HaBehirot HaMerkazit) (https://www.gov.il/en/departments/central-elections-committee/govil-landing-page).

The following rules govern the merging, joint contention, and splitting of listed parties:

- If Likud or Together (or any successor party created through a merger) merge with or contest the election jointly with any other party, the option corresponding to Likud or Together will represent the resultant candidate list or merged party. 

Otherwise:

- If a listed party merges with, or contests the election as part of a joint candidate list with, one or more unlisted parties prior to the election, the option corresponding to the listed party will represent all seats won by the merged party or joint candidate list. If a listed party merges with, or contests the election as part of a joint candidate list with, one or more other listed parties prior to the election, the option corresponding to the party which held the most seats in the prior Knesset will represent all seats won by the merged party/joint candidate list. If these rules do not adequately determine which option represents a merged party or joint candidate list, the listed party whose name, as listed in this market, comes first in alphabetical order, will represent all seats won by the merged party or joint candidate list.

- If a listed party splits into multiple parties prior to the election, the option corresponding to the listed party will represent the resulting party that holds the greatest number of seats in the Israeli Knesset as a result of the split. If these rules do not adequately determine which party represents a listed option after a split, the listed option will represent all seats won by the party resulting from the split whose primary English name comes first in alphabetical order.

recent_facts.fact: CPI-U for all items rose 3.4% in the 12 months to August 2026 before seasonal adjustment, the same 12-month rate as in July. The August 2026 index (not seasonally adjusted) was 334.980, which is 1982-84=100.

In August 2026, CPI-U rose 0.4% seasonally adjusted (July: +0.1%) and 0.3% not seasonally adjusted. Gasoline rose 3.9% seasonally adjusted in the month and made up over a third of the all-items increase. Over 12 months, energy was up 16.3% and gasoline 27.4%.
Core CPI (all items less food and energy) rose 2.4% in the 12 months to August 2026, down from 2.5% in the 12 months to July.

recent_facts.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (September 2025 CPI release)
recent_facts.fact: The September 2025 CPI-U index (not seasonally adjusted) was 324.800, and the 12-month rate was 3.0%. The August 2025 index was 323.976, so the index rose about 0.25% from August to September 2025 before seasonal adjustment. Desk arithmetic: for BLS to print 3.7% or higher, the September 2026 index must be about 336.66 or higher, roughly a 0.50% rise from August 2026 before seasonal adjustment. A print of exactly 3.6% (which resolves No) covers an index of about 336.49 to 336.65.
AAA's national average for regular gasoline was $4.14 on Sep 3, $4.27 on Sep 10, $4.43 on Sep 17 and $4.48 on Sep 24, 2026. AAA said the Sep 24 price was the highest ever for that time of year.

AAA said September 2026's average to date was $4.30 per gallon, a record for the month (the previous September record was $3.83 in 2023). It linked the rise to volatility in the Strait of Hormuz and crude oil near $100 per barrel.

AAA's August 2026 weekly national averages were $4.06 (Aug 6), $4.07 (Aug 13), $4.10 (Aug 20) and $4.09 (Aug 27). That means the August average was about $4.08, and the September average to date of $4.30 is roughly 5% higher.
As of mid-September 2026, AAA said the national average gas price was more than $1 higher than a year earlier. Crude oil averaged about $100 per barrel, up from about $90 in early September.
BLS has scheduled the September 2026 CPI release for Wednesday, October 14, 2026, at 8:30 a.m. ET, which is the day the question closes.

A continuing resolution signed on Sep 2, 2026 funds federal agencies through December 11, 2026. That averts an October 1 shutdown, so no shutdown-related delay to the October 14 CPI release is expected.
The question resolves on the 12-month all-items CPI-U change, unadjusted, as BLS reports it to one decimal place. Only a value of 3.7% or higher counts as 'above 3.6%'.

market.question: US-Iran Hormuz Agreement by October 15?
market.rules:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if a diplomatic agreement between the United States and Iran over traffic in the strait of Hormuz is announced by the specified date, 11:59 PM ET.

A diplomatic agreement refers to an official agreement, treaty, deal, or substantially similar diplomatic instrument that establishes agreed actions, policies, obligations, or commitments between the United States and Iran.

A qualifying diplomatic agreement must establish Iranian policies, obligations, or commitments  aimed at permitting, restoring, or increasing vessel or shipping traffic through the Strait of Hormuz.

All listed countries must announce their acceptance of the same qualifying diplomatic agreement for the Payout Condition to be met. A joint announcement will qualify, as will separate announcements from each entity of its own acceptance of an agreement which, taken together, directly indicate that all the listed countries accepted the same agreement. Separate announcements of individual policies will not qualify if the policies are not announced as part of a diplomatic agreement.

Each announcement must be a declarative statement that clearly and unambiguously communicates acceptance of an agreement. Statements that reference ongoing negotiations or a prospective agreement, or that allude to or express support for an agreement without confirming acceptance of the agreement, do not qualify. A qualifying announcement need not reference the agreement by name or use specific terminology, provided it clearly communicates acceptance of an agreement.
 
Whether announcements from the listed countries represent a diplomatic agreement and whether such an agreement qualifies will be primarily determined through the announcements themselves. Where an announcement is made by all listed countries but, based on the announcements, it remains ambiguous whether the announcements represent a qualifying diplomatic agreement between the countries, this market will remain open until either i) definitive confirmation that the announcements represent a qualifying diplomatic agreement between the listed entities is achieved through further announcements from the listed countries or a consensus of credible reporting or ii) 14 calendar days (ET) have passed after the date that the last country made their first potentially qualifying announcement. If, at the end of the fourteenth calendar day, no definitive confirmation has been achieved, this market will resolve based on the totality of information available from the resolution sources at that time. No single statement, denial, or presentation of evidence will govern where it is contradicted by the totality of information.

The resolution sources for this market will be official information from the governments of the United States and Iran and a consensus of credible reporting.

market.question: US announces end of Iranian blockade by October 15, 2026?
market.rules:
On July 13, 2026, Trump announced the United States would reinstate its naval blockade of Iran, targeting Iranian ships and customers.

This market will resolve to “Yes” if the United States government, or an authorized representative of the United States government, publicly and officially announces the end, termination, lifting, or suspension of the United States’ naval blockade on Iranian ships and ships of Iranian customers, between market creation and the specified date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

An announcement qualifies if it communicates that the United States will generally cease blocking vessel traffic for Iranian ships and customers, including an announcement that the blockade will not take effect at all, even if some restrictions remain (for example, an imposition of fees). An announcement does not qualify if it reflects only a limited or partial change that stops short of a general end or suspension of the blockade, for example, an exemption for a specific vessel, cargo, or port.

A qualifying announcement must be a declarative statement of the United States government’s present termination or suspension of the blockade, previously-unannounced prior termination or suspension of the blockade, or definitive decision to terminate or suspend the blockade.

A qualifying announcement must clearly and unambiguously identify the end or suspension of the blockade. Statements that merely allude to, reference, or describe an end to the blockade, without clearly communicating it, do not qualify. The announcement need not use specific terminology or reference the end of a blockade by name; an announcement of a resumption of prior obligations, the maintenance of a status quo, or a return to a previously agreed baseline qualifies, provided the substantive policy of ending or suspending the blockade is clearly and unambiguously communicated.

A qualifying announcement must be made through official channels, by an individual acting in an official capacity. Statements made incidentally or informally in a context not intended for official communication do not qualify.

The following do not qualify:

Anonymous, unattributed, or leaked statements not confirmed as official;
Statements by persons not authorized to speak for the United States government;
Third-party speculation, analysis, or predictions that the United States government will announce or implement an end to the blockade;
Satirical, fabricated, hacked, or impersonated communications; and
Statements that describe a prospective, contingent, probable, or conditional end to the blockade rather than announcing a present and decided position.

Once a qualifying announcement is made, this market will resolve to “Yes” regardless of whether it is later reversed, or whether the blockade actually ends in practice.

Resolution will be based on official information from the United States government, including the President, the Department of Defense, the Department of State, and United States Central Command (CENTCOM), or the official representatives of the United States government.

Percentages of the valid votes received by each candidate will be determined by dividing the total number of valid votes each of the top two candidates receives by the sum of all valid votes cast in the election.

market.question: Will Guilherme Derrite win the most votes in the 2026 São Paulo Senate election?
market.rules:
The Brazilian Federal Senate election for São Paulo is scheduled to take place on October 4, 2026.

This market will resolve according to the candidate who wins the most valid votes of any candidate at the specified election.

Candidates will be primarily ranked by order of valid votes won. If two or more candidates are tied for any position, ties will be broken by alphabetical order of the candidates’ listed full names as they appear in this market. This market will resolve to the candidate that occupies the highest finishing position after applying this ranking.

If the result of this election isn't definitively known by June 30, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, the market will resolve to "Other".

This market will resolve based on the result of the election, as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as reported by the Brazilian government, specifically the Superior Electoral Court (Tribunal Superior Eleitoral, TSE) (e.g., www.tse.jus.br/eleicoes/resultados-eleicoes).

recent_facts.fact: In Quaest's poll of 1,800 voters (fieldwork Sept 25–28, margin ±2 pts, registration SP-01590/2026), first and second Senate choices combined show Guilherme Derrite (PP) at 18%, Marina Silva (Rede) at 15% and Simone Tebet (PSB) at 15%. This page gives André do Prado (PL) 8%.

It gives André do Prado 12% (up from 8%), which conflicts with the 8% on NC News. 79% could not name a candidate in the unprompted question.

Datafolha (fieldwork Sept 22–23, margin ±2 pts), both seats combined: Marina Silva 15%, Simone Tebet 14%, Derrite 12%, André do Prado 12%, Ricardo Salles 4%. All four leaders are within the margin of error of each other.

market.question: Will Renan Santos win 8% or more of the valid vote in the first round of the 2026 Brazilian presidential election?
market.rules:
A presidential election is scheduled to take place in Brazil on October 4, 2026.

This market will resolve according to the percentage of valid votes received by Renan Santos in the first round of this election.

The percentage of valid votes received by the specified candidate will be determined by dividing the total number of valid votes the candidate receives in the first round by the sum of all valid votes cast in the first round.

If the reported value falls exactly between two brackets, then this market will resolve to the higher range bracket.

If the specified candidate does not appear on the ballot in the first round, or otherwise receives no valid votes, this market will resolve to the lowest range bracket.

This market will resolve based on the official vote count.

If a recount is initiated before the vote total has been made official, the market will remain open until the recount is completed and the vote is made official.

If the result of this election isn't known definitively by June 30, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to the lowest range bracket.

This market will resolve based on the result of the election, as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as reported by the Brazilian government, including the Superior Electoral Court (Tribunal Superior Eleitoral, TSE) (e.g., https://dadosabertos.tse.jus.br/).

market.question: Will Renan Santos finish in third place in the first round of the 2026 Brazilian presidential election?

A presidential election is scheduled to take place in Brazil on October 4, 2026.

This market will resolve according to the listed candidate who receives the third-most valid votes in the first round of this election.

The named candidates will be primarily ranked by the number of valid votes received in the specified election. If two or more candidates are tied on valid votes, ties will be broken by alphabetical order of the candidates' last names. This market will resolve to the candidate that occupies the third-highest finishing position after applying this ranking.

If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as reported by the Brazilian government, specifically the Superior Electoral Court (Tribunal Superior Eleitoral, TSE) (e.g., https://dadosabertos.tse.jus.br/).

recent_facts.source: ESPNcricinfo (search-result summary of the Australia A tour of India 2026 series page)
recent_facts.fact: On day 3 (1 Oct) of the 2nd unofficial Test in Puducherry, a live update showed Australia A 358 & 95/2 against India A 167, a lead of 286 runs. This came from a search snippet and was not read in full. It was not marked as the close of play.

Other day-3 snippets disagree. One showed Australia A 12/0 in their second innings with a lead of 203, labelled 'end of Day 3'. That label is probably wrong, since 203 is the lead right after India A were all out for 167. Another showed 'Day 3, Session 2, Australia A leads by 275'. Every snippet has Australia A batting again with a lead of about 200–286 and no result yet.

recent_facts.source: Social News XYZ / ESPNcricinfo match report
recent_facts.fact: At stumps on day 2, India A were 122/5 in reply to Australia A's 358, still 236 behind. Todd Murphy had 2/26 from 17 overs and Liam Scott 1/10 from 9 overs. Shaik Rasheed was 36 not out.
Australia A took their overnight 282/7 on to 358 all out. Sam Harper made 128 on his Australia A debut and was caught behind off Tanush Kotian.

This is a four-day match scheduled for 29 Sep – 2 Oct 2026. Only day 4 (2 Oct) remains after today, so Australia A would need to declare, then bowl India A out in roughly a day or less. India A cannot be asked to follow on, because Australia A are already batting again.

The Puducherry pitch was described as giving 'sharp turn' and 'inconsistent bounce' that helped spinners, with low deliveries harder to play by the final session of day 2. Off-spinners Murphy and Corey Rocchiccioli dismissed three left-handers from India A's top five.

India A won the 1st unofficial Test at the same ground (CAP Siechem, Puducherry, 22–25 Sep) by 162 runs: India A 334 & 199, Australia A 171 & 200. The four-day match ended with a result, and Todd Murphy took 4/48 in India A's second innings.

In the previous series in India (2025, Lucknow), the 1st unofficial Test was a high-scoring draw and India A won the 2nd by 5 wickets after chasing more than 400. This sample of 2 matches is very small and the count is unverified.

recent_facts.fact: On day 3 (1 Oct) of the 2nd unofficial Test in Puducherry, a live update showed Australia A 358 & 95/2 against India A 167, a lead of 286 runs. This came from a search snippet and was not read in full. It was not marked as the close of play.

Other day-3 snippets disagree. One showed Australia A 12/0 in their second innings with a lead of 203, labelled 'end of Day 3'. That label is probably wrong, since 203 is the lead right after India A were all out for 167. Another showed 'Day 3, Session 2, Australia A leads by 275'. Every snippet has Australia A batting again with a lead of about 200–286 and no result yet.

recent_facts.source: Social News XYZ / ESPNcricinfo match report
recent_facts.fact: At stumps on day 2, India A were 122/5 in reply to Australia A's 358, still 236 behind. Todd Murphy had 2/26 from 17 overs and Liam Scott 1/10 from 9 overs. Shaik Rasheed was 36 not out.
Australia A took their overnight 282/7 on to 358 all out. Sam Harper made 128 on his Australia A debut and was caught behind off Tanush Kotian.

This is a four-day match scheduled for 29 Sep – 2 Oct 2026. Only day 4 (2 Oct) remains after today, so Australia A would need to declare, then bowl India A out in roughly a day or less. India A cannot be asked to follow on, because Australia A are already batting again.

The Puducherry pitch was described as giving 'sharp turn' and 'inconsistent bounce' that helped spinners, with low deliveries harder to play by the final session of day 2. Off-spinners Murphy and Corey Rocchiccioli dismissed three left-handers from India A's top five.

India A won the 1st unofficial Test at the same ground (CAP Siechem, Puducherry, 22–25 Sep) by 162 runs: India A 334 & 199, Australia A 171 & 200. The four-day match ended with a result, and Todd Murphy took 4/48 in India A's second innings.

In the previous series in India (2025, Lucknow), the 1st unofficial Test was a high-scoring draw and India A won the 2nd by 5 wickets after chasing more than 400. This sample of 2 matches is very small and the count is unverified.

recent_facts.fact: Denmark host Portugal in UEFA Nations League 2026-27 League A, Group 4, at Parken Stadium in Copenhagen. Kickoff is Thursday, October 1, 2026, at 18:45 GMT (20:45 local). As of this research, no source published after kickoff reported a result.

Portugal captain Cristiano Ronaldo left the training camp in Copenhagen after a reported rift with new head coach Jorge Jesus. Jesus had said Ronaldo would not start against Denmark, after he went unused on the bench in the win over Norway. On Instagram, Ronaldo said he had decided to leave the camp and wished his teammates luck.
Portugal lead Group 4 with 6 points from 2 games: they beat Wales 1-0 and won 2-1 away at Norway. Denmark have 3 points: they lost 3-2 away at Norway and beat Wales 2-0 at home.

Denmark are without Patrick Dorgu (hamstring) and Albert Grønbæk (thigh), who were both withdrawn from the squad. Alexander Bah (shoulder) and Andreas Christensen (hamstring) are also listed as unavailable.
Al Jazeera lists Portugal's Bruno Fernandes as sidelined with physical discomfort.
Goal reports that Francisco Conceição was injured in Oslo against Norway and is unlikely to be risked by Portugal.

Al Jazeera puts the all-time head-to-head at 17 matches: 11 Portugal wins, 4 Denmark wins and 2 draws. The Hard Tackle gives 18 meetings (12 Portugal wins, 2 draws, 4 Denmark wins), so the sources disagree on the count.

The last meeting at Parken was the March 20, 2025 Nations League quarter-final first leg, which Denmark won 1-0 with a goal from substitute Rasmus Højlund. Christian Eriksen had a first-half penalty saved.

In the second leg in Lisbon on March 23, 2025, Portugal beat Denmark 5-2 after extra time and went through 5-3 on aggregate. Because the tie went to extra time, the score after 90 minutes was closer than 5-2.
Recent form over the last 5 games: Denmark W-L-D-D-W, Portugal W-W-L-W-D.
Portugal have lost 1 of their last 12 matches in all competitions. Denmark have won 2 of their 7 most recent completed fixtures, drawing 3 and losing 2.

The field includes seven players from the world top 50: Fitzpatrick (4), Fleetwood (9), Rose (16), MacIntyre (19), Noren (21), Hatton (24) and Straka (35).

Hatton missed the cut at the Amgen Irish Open (September 10–13) with rounds of 78-70 (148, +8).

Hatton is playing seven DP World Tour events between LIV Golf's final event in Indianapolis and the DP World Tour's season-ending playoffs, and the Dunhill Links is the fourth of them. market.question: Will Real Madrid CF win on 2026-10-10?
market.rules:
In the upcoming game, scheduled for October 10, 2026
If Real Madrid CF wins, this market will resolve to "Yes".
Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".
If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed.
If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve "No".
This market refers only to the outcome within the first 90 minutes of regular play plus stoppage time.

The primary resolution source for this market is the official statistics of the event as recognized by the governing body or event organizers. However, if the governing body or event organizers have not published final match statistics within 2 hours after the event's conclusion, data from Flashscore may be used; if Flashscore data is unavailable, data from Sofascore may be used; if neither is available, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead. All markets will settle based on the official final result as recognized by the governing body or event organizers. Revisions to officially declared final scores made after market resolution will not be accounted for in determining the outcome. If no acceptable data is available within 24 hours of the event's conclusion, this market will resolve 50-50, or to "Draw" where applicable.

recent_facts.fact: Only the result after 90 minutes plus stoppage time counts. A draw resolves No, and only a Real Madrid win resolves Yes.
Real Madrid host Villarreal in LaLiga at the Bernabéu on Saturday, October 10, 2026, at 9:00 pm CEST (19:00 UTC). It is Real Madrid's first league match after the international break.
After 7 matchdays, Real Madrid are 4th with 15 points (5W-0D-2L, GD +10). Villarreal are 9th with 8 points (2W-2D-3L, GD +1).

Real Madrid's league results: 2-1 at Espanyol, 4-1 v Real Sociedad (H), 4-0 v Málaga (H), 0-1 at Betis, 4-1 v Rayo (H), 3-2 at Elche, 1-2 at Atlético (Sep 20). That is 3 wins from 3 at home in the league. They also beat Inter 2-1 at home in the Champions League on Sep 8.
Centre-back Dean Huijsen was given a one-match ban for his straight red card in the Sep 20 derby, which rules him out against Villarreal on Oct 10. Real Madrid's appeal was rejected.

Real Madrid confirmed that Kylian Mbappé (7 league goals, the team's top scorer) has a hyperextension of the posterior capsule of his left knee. The club gave no return date. Other reports said he would be out for about two weeks, which leaves him a doubt for Oct 10.
Captain Federico Valverde suffered a grade 3 left ankle sprain in the derby against Atlético. He was expected to miss two to three weeks, so his availability for Oct 10 is uncertain.
José Mourinho is Real Madrid's head coach this season, on a contract to June 2029. Villarreal signed midfielder Nathan Saliba in the summer.
Across 55 all-time meetings, Real Madrid have 32 wins, Villarreal 6, and 17 were draws. At the Bernabéu the record is Real Madrid 12 wins, 11 draws, Villarreal 4 (27 games).

Real Madrid have won their last three home games against Villarreal: 4-1 in December 2023, 2-0 in October 2024 and 3-1 in October 2025. The latest meeting overall was a 2-0 Real Madrid win at Villarreal on January 24, 2026. This is a small sample.
After Villarreal, Real Madrid play Sevilla at home on Oct 18 and Barcelona away on Oct 25. Reports say Mbappé could be rested against Villarreal.

recent_facts.fact: On day 3 (1 Oct) of the 2nd unofficial Test in Puducherry, a live update showed Australia A 358 & 95/2 against India A 167, a lead of 286 runs. This came from a search snippet and was not read in full. It was not marked as the close of play.

Other day-3 snippets disagree. One showed Australia A 12/0 in their second innings with a lead of 203, labelled 'end of Day 3'. That label is probably wrong, since 203 is the lead right after India A were all out for 167. Another showed 'Day 3, Session 2, Australia A leads by 275'. Every snippet has Australia A batting again with a lead of about 200–286 and no result yet.

recent_facts.fact: At stumps on day 2, India A were 122/5 in reply to Australia A's 358, still 236 behind. Todd Murphy had 2/26 from 17 overs and Liam Scott 1/10 from 9 overs. Shaik Rasheed was 36 not out.
