market.rules:
If the Consumer Price Index (CPI) increases by more than 3.5% in the twelve months ending September 2026 (as represented by the one-decimal place value reported by the Bureau of Labor Statistics), then the market resolves to Yes.
In the case of a delay in data caused by a federal government shutdown impacting the reliability of the Source Agency, the market’s latest Expiration Date will be extended to the sooner of the release of the Underlying or six months after the end of the
government shutdown

recent_facts.fact: CPI-U for all items rose 3.4% in the 12 months to August 2026 before seasonal adjustment, the same 12-month rate as in July. The August 2026 index (not seasonally adjusted) was 334.980, which is 1982-84=100.
Core CPI (all items less food and energy) rose 2.4% in the 12 months to August 2026, down from 2.5% in the 12 months to July.

recent_facts.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (September 2025 CPI release)
recent_facts.fact: The September 2025 CPI-U index (not seasonally adjusted) was 324.800, and the 12-month rate was 3.0%. The August 2025 index was 323.976, so the index rose about 0.25% from August to September 2025 before seasonal adjustment. Desk arithmetic: for BLS to print 3.7% or higher, the September 2026 index must be about 336.66 or higher, roughly a 0.50% rise from August 2026 before seasonal adjustment. A print of exactly 3.6% (which resolves No) covers an index of about 336.49 to 336.65.
AAA's national average for regular gasoline was $4.14 on Sep 3, $4.27 on Sep 10, $4.43 on Sep 17 and $4.48 on Sep 24, 2026. AAA said the Sep 24 price was the highest ever for that time of year.

AAA said September 2026's average to date was $4.30 per gallon, a record for the month (the previous September record was $3.83 in 2023). It linked the rise to volatility in the Strait of Hormuz and crude oil near $100 per barrel.

AAA's August 2026 weekly national averages were $4.06 (Aug 6), $4.07 (Aug 13), $4.10 (Aug 20) and $4.09 (Aug 27). That means the August average was about $4.08, and the September average to date of $4.30 is roughly 5% higher.
As of mid-September 2026, AAA said the national average gas price was more than $1 higher than a year earlier. Crude oil averaged about $100 per barrel, up from about $90 in early September.
BLS has scheduled the September 2026 CPI release for Wednesday, October 14, 2026, at 8:30 a.m. ET, which is the day the question closes.

A continuing resolution signed on Sep 2, 2026 funds federal agencies through December 11, 2026. That averts an October 1 shutdown, so no shutdown-related delay to the October 14 CPI release is expected.
The question resolves on the 12-month all-items CPI-U change, unadjusted, as BLS reports it to one decimal place. Only a value of 3.7% or higher counts as 'above 3.6%'.

market.question: Will the unemployment rate (U-3) be above 4.2% in September? (Above 4.2%)
market.rules: If the seasonally adjusted unemployment rate (U-3) reported by the Bureau of Labor Statistics in the Employment Situation Report is above 4.2% in September 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.

recent_facts.source: Bureau of Labor Statistics, Employment Situation Summary (August 2026)
recent_facts.fact: The seasonally adjusted U-3 unemployment rate was unchanged at 4.1% in August 2026, with 7.0 million people unemployed. For the September figure to be 3.9% or lower, the rate would have to fall by at least 0.2 percentage points in one month.

Nonfarm payrolls rose 162,000 in August 2026, compared with an average gain of 31,000 a month over the prior 12 months. Unemployment rates were 4.0% for adult men, 3.5% for adult women and 14.1% for teenagers.
Labor force participation edged up to 61.6% in August 2026, still below January's level. June and July payrolls were revised up by a combined 55,000.

The unemployment rate fell from 4.2% in June to 4.1% in July 2026 even though payrolls fell by 23,000. The drop came mainly from people leaving the labor force: participation fell to 61.4%, its lowest in more than five years.
Bloomberg described 4.1% as a one-year low for the unemployment rate, meaning the rate has not been below 4.1% at any point in the past year.
Initial jobless claims were 197,000 for the week ending September 19, 2026, down from 198,000 the week before. Continuing claims fell to 1.719 million.
Jobless claims fell to 196,000 during the holiday week, which included the September CPS survey reference week around September 12. Continuing claims also dropped.
The September 2026 Employment Situation report is scheduled for Friday, October 2, 2026, at 8:30 a.m. ET (12:30 UTC). The question closes one minute earlier, at 12:29 UTC.

The House passed a continuing resolution 370-48, and the Senate had earlier passed it 90-6. It funds the government through December 11, 2026, and was signed into law, so there is no shutdown on October 1 to delay the BLS release (unlike the October 2025 shutdown, which cancelled the October 2025 household survey).
BLS publishes U-3 rounded to one decimal place, from the household survey (CPS). 'Above 3.9%' therefore resolves Yes if the published September rate is 4.0% or higher.

market.question: Will Renan Santos win between 2% and 4% of the valid vote in the first round of the 2026 Brazilian presidential election?
market.rules:
A presidential election is scheduled to take place in Brazil on October 4, 2026.

This market will resolve according to the percentage of valid votes received by Renan Santos in the first round of this election.

The percentage of valid votes received by the specified candidate will be determined by dividing the total number of valid votes the candidate receives in the first round by the sum of all valid votes cast in the first round.

If the reported value falls exactly between two brackets, then this market will resolve to the higher range bracket.

If the specified candidate does not appear on the ballot in the first round, or otherwise receives no valid votes, this market will resolve to the lowest range bracket.

This market will resolve based on the official vote count.

If a recount is initiated before the vote total has been made official, the market will remain open until the recount is completed and the vote is made official.

If the result of this election isn't known definitively by June 30, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to the lowest range bracket.

This market will resolve based on the result of the election, as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as reported by the Brazilian government, including the Superior Electoral Court (Tribunal Superior Eleitoral, TSE) (e.g., https://dadosabertos.tse.jus.br/).

recent_facts.source: Wikipedia – Opinion polling for the 2026 Brazilian presidential election
recent_facts.fact: First-round polls fielded Sept 23–29, as a share of all respondents: Indexa 3%, Futura 3.2%, Vox Brasil 2.7%, Ideia 4.5%, AtlasIntel 5.2%, Nexus 4%, Quaest 3% and Palver 8%. Only Palver (Sept 24–27; Lula 44, Flávio 44, blank/null/undecided 2) reached 8% or more.

Quaest polled Sept 24–27 and released on Sept 28: Renan Santos 3%, Lula 39%, Flávio Bolsonaro 34%, Cury 4%, Caiado 4%. The Wikipedia table lists 15% blank/null/undecided for this poll, so 3% is a share of all respondents, not of valid votes.
A late-September Real Time Big Data poll of Paraná state put Renan Santos at 4% of valid votes in that state. Flávio had 53%, Lula 33% and Cury 5%.
A Palver poll released Sept 21 (5,000 respondents) had Renan Santos at 11% in the first round. Palver's next poll (Sept 24–27) had him at 8%.

TSE president Kassio Nunes Marques ruled that TV Globo does not have to invite Renan Santos to its Oct 1 presidential debate. Under electoral law, invitations go to parties that elected at least 5 federal deputies in 2022, and Missão has 1 (Kim Kataguiri).

Globo's debate rules let it invite, at its discretion, the best-placed candidate in the Sept 28 Quaest poll who does not meet the legal criteria. Reports say Lula would skip the Globo debate, which raised whether Santos would be invited. The TSE ruling said Globo was not obliged to invite him.

Datafolha's July 22–23 first-round poll had Renan Santos at 4%, with 11% undecided. Flávio Bolsonaro had 40%, Lula 32%, Caiado 3%, Cury 3% and Zema 2%. No late-September Datafolha figure for Santos turned up.
Terra reports Renan Santos polling between 4% and 7.8% in first-round surveys, usually in third place nationally.
Globo's presidential debate is on Oct 1, 2026, and the first round of voting is on Oct 4, 2026. The question resolves on the TSE's official share of valid votes, which excludes blank and null votes.

recent_facts.fact: UFC 332 is set for October 3, 2026 at the Delta Center in Salt Lake City, with Natália Silva vs. Wang Cong for the vacant UFC Women's Flyweight Championship as the headliner. No withdrawal or change to the main event is listed. The only late change mentioned is on the undercard: bantamweight Bernardo Sopaj pulled out with an injury and Anthony Romero replaced him.

The main event was first booked as Valentina Shevchenko defending the title against Natália Silva. Shevchenko withdrew with a ligament injury to her back and shoulder that is expected to keep her out for a year, so the title was vacated and Wang Cong stepped in to face Silva.

Silva is 20-5-1, the No. 1-ranked women's flyweight contender, and has won 14 fights in a row. She is 8-0 in the UFC since 2022, and her last three wins came against former champions Jessica Andrade, Alexa Grasso and Rose Namajunas.
Wang is 10-1 and ranked in the top 10. She has won four straight since the only loss of her pro career, to Gabriella Fernandes in 2024. She also beat Valentina Shevchenko in a 2015 kickboxing match.

In her last fight, at UFC 329 on 2026-07-11, Wang beat Tracy Cortez by unanimous decision, 29-27 on all three cards. She won despite a one-point deduction for an illegal knee to the head. That bout was at flyweight.

Wang started 1-1 in the UFC before her four straight wins, and two of those four wins came at catchweight rather than flyweight. For example, her February 7, 2026 fight with Eduarda Moura was at a 127.5 lb catchweight after both fighters missed weight (per UFCalendar). Weight-cut history is relevant at a title weigh-in, but the market resolves only on who wins the fight.

UFC says Wang has the highest striking differential in the women's flyweight division and is the most accurate striker in the division's history. It describes Silva as a fast, kick-heavy striker with strong footwork. Both fighters lean on striking.

The title fight is scheduled for five rounds and will be held at altitude in Salt Lake City. Neither fighter has headlined a UFC event before, and as far as these sources show, neither has fought a five-round UFC bout.

In fight-week interviews, Wang called Silva the toughest opponent she has faced in the UFC and praised her distance management and kicking. Neither this coverage nor any other found reports an injury for either fighter.
Wang's amateur background includes gold medals at the 2013 World Wushu Championships and the 2014 Asian Games, plus a silver in amateur boxing at the 2019 World Championships. Her UFC record is 5-1.

The 14-fight card runs Saturday, October 3: early prelims at 4 PM ET, prelims at 6 PM ET, and the main card at 8 PM ET on CBS and Paramount+. Official weigh-ins are normally held the day before the event.

market.question: Will the upper bound of the federal funds rate be above 4.00% following the Fed's Oct 28, 2026 meeting? (Above 4.00%)
market.rules:
If the upper bound of the target federal funds rate published on the Federal Reserve's official website is greater than 4.00% following the Federal Reserve's Oct 28, 2026 meeting, then the market resolves to Yes.
This market will expire the first 2:05 PM ET following the release of a Federal Reserve statement for their Oct 28, 2026 meeting or one week following the last day of that meeting.

recent_facts.fact: At its September 16, 2026 meeting the FOMC voted 12-0 to raise the federal funds target range by 25 bp to 3.75%–4.00%. The upper bound is now exactly 4.00%, so the question resolves Yes only if the Fed hikes again on October 28.
The September move raised the range from 3.50%–3.75% to 3.75%–4.00%. It was the Fed's first rate increase since 2023.

The September SEP median puts the fed funds rate at 4.125% for end-2026 and end-2027, which implies one more 25 bp hike in 2026. The long-run neutral rate rose to 3.25%. Chair Warsh called the hike 'removing accommodation' and said the Fed's 'predominant focus is on the price stability side.'
16 of 19 FOMC participants projected at least one more rate hike in 2026. The remaining 2026 meetings are October 27–28 and December.

New York Fed President John Williams said that after the September hike he sees 'no need for urgency' and that 'we have time to gather more information.' He backed one more hike 'late this year,' which the article reads as pointing to December rather than October.
On September 29, Fed Governor Michael Barr said more hikes are likely needed, and Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee also leaned hawkish. Williams stood out by seeing no urgency.
Coverage of the Fed's No. 2 official (Williams, as NY Fed president and FOMC vice chair) reported that he said there is no rush to hike again.
At the September 16 press conference, Warsh said: 'Inflation is too high and has been for too long.' He described inflation of about 3% as still too high.

Before the September meeting, Vice President JD Vance said the Trump administration believes the Fed should lower rates rather than raise them. Governor Waller said his decision depended on the inflation data.

Data due before the October 28 decision: the September jobs report (Friday, October 2) and September CPI (October 14). The next PCE report comes out October 29, the day after the decision, so September CPI is the last major inflation reading the Fed will see.
The next FOMC decision is October 28, 2026, followed by a December meeting. MUFG's September recap expected the Fed to skip October and hike in December.

UNVERIFIED, recalled from memory and based on very few cases: after the first hike of a tightening cycle, the Fed hiked again at the next meeting in 2004 and 2022 but not in 2015 (a one-year pause). The 1999 cycle also had a skipped meeting early on.

market.rules:

If MrBeast Gaming does not post a YouTube video by October 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to the lowest range bracket.

If the reported value falls exactly between two brackets, then this market will resolve to the higher range bracket.

The resolution source for this market is MrBeast Gaming's YouTube channel (https://www.youtube.com/@MrBeastGaming), specifically the 'views' counter for the described video.

Note: This market refers to MrBeast Gaming's next video to be posted. Shorts, previews, or other videos released other than the referenced video will not be considered.

recent_facts.fact: MrBeast Gaming's latest known long-form upload is 'I Found My 13 Year Old Minecraft World', posted on September 26, 2026. The article says it reached 'tens of millions of views in about two days' but gives no exact figure. It puts the channel at about 59.6 million subscribers in September 2026. Because this video came out before today, the market's 'next video' has to be a later upload.

MrBeast Gaming's 'Worlds Largest Minecraft Build!' (sponsored by MrBeast Lab) ranked #1 among the week's branded videos with 44,043,717 views. The report does not say what time window that count covers.
MrBeast Gaming's 'Whatever You Hide As, You Keep!' (sponsored by Feastables) ranked #1 among the week's branded videos with 47,456,973 views. The report does not say the measurement window.

Unverified, small sample: the two MrBeast Gaming videos in Tubefilter's September 2026 weekly charts showed about 44.0M and 47.5M views. Both are above the 30–35M and 35–40M brackets, but it is not clear whether those figures are first-week (168-hour) counts.

recent_facts.source: MrBeast Updates on X / web search snippet
recent_facts.fact: A search snippet said the September 26 MrBeast Gaming video had 'over 4.3 million views' on the day it was posted. This early figure is unverified.

MrBeast Gaming posted long-form videos around early September, mid-September ('Worlds Largest Minecraft Build!') and September 26. If nothing is posted by October 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, the market resolves to the lowest bracket.

market.question: Will there be no change in Fed interest rates after the October 2026 meeting?
market.rules:
The FED interest rates are defined in this market by the upper bound of the target federal funds range. The decisions on the target federal funds range are made by the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meetings.

This market will resolve to the amount of basis points the upper bound of the target federal funds rate is changed by versus the level it was prior to the Federal Reserve's October 2026 meeting.

If the target federal funds rate is changed to a level not expressed in the displayed options, the change will be rounded up to the nearest 25 and will resolve to the relevant bracket. (e.g. if there's a cut/increase of 12.5 bps it will be considered to be 25 bps)

The resolution source for this market is the FOMC’s statement after its meeting scheduled for October 27-28, 2026 according to the official calendar: https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm.

The level and change of the target federal funds rate is also published at the official website of the Federal Reserve at https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/openmarket.htm.

This market may resolve as soon as the FOMC’s statement for their October meeting with relevant data is issued. If no statement is released by the end date of the next scheduled meeting, this market will resolve to the "No change" bracket.

recent_facts.fact: No. 7 Alabama (4-0, 2-0 SEC) plays at No. 16 Mississippi State (4-0, 2-0 SEC) on Saturday, October 3, 2026, at 11:00 a.m. at Davis Wade Stadium in Starkville, on ABC. Mississippi State is the home team.

recent_facts.source: Wikipedia (2026 Alabama Crimson Tide football team)

recent_facts.source: Wikipedia (2026 Mississippi State Bulldogs football team)
recent_facts.fact: Mississippi State's 2026 results: beat Louisiana-Monroe 62-13 at home, won at Minnesota 38-13, won at South Carolina 41-34 and beat No. 19 Missouri 31-24 at home. The coach is Jeff Lebby (3rd season).

The first SEC availability report (Wednesday, Sept 30) lists eight Alabama players as uncertain. Starting right tackle Jayvin James is Questionable with a lower-extremity injury from the South Carolina game. Edge defenders Justin Hill and Desmond Umeozulu remain out.

DeBoer said he expects left guard Will Sanders (upper body) to play. He also expects DB Zay Mincey, who was a late pregame scratch against South Carolina, to be ready this weekend. Umeozulu will be out further into the season than Hill.

On the first SEC availability report, Mississippi State starting safety Isaac Smith and RB Fluff Bothwell are both listed as Probable. Smith left the Missouri game in the first half with a right shoulder injury and wore a sling in the second half.

Mississippi State sophomore QB Kamario Taylor is tied for the FBS lead with 14 touchdown passes through Week 4. Missouri sacked him four times and hurried him twice. Lebby said his team is 'dinged-up' like everyone else in the league.
Alabama's defensive coordinator called Mississippi State QB Kamario Taylor the best quarterback Alabama has faced this season.
After this game, Alabama hosts Georgia on Oct 10. Mississippi State's next game is at LSU on Oct 17. A final SEC availability report is due before Saturday's 11 a.m. kickoff.

The Bears beat the Eagles 27-7 on Monday Night Football in Chicago on Sept 28. Case Keenum threw two touchdowns in his first start in almost three years, and the Bears shut down Jalen Hurts.

Seven points was the Eagles' lowest total since 2021 and ended a franchise-record streak of 75 games with at least 10 points. Under new OC Sean Mannion, Philadelphia has thrown a league-low 15 play-action passes in three games, and the paper says the defense under Vic Fangio has declined, with missed tackles and coverage breakdowns.

Rams WR Puka Nacua practiced on a limited basis for the first time in two weeks (hip; other sources say groin) and is expected to play Sunday. CB Jaylen Watson is ruled out and Terrance Ferguson is extremely doubtful. TE Colby Parkinson (knee/shoulder) missed practice. S Kam Kinchens (hamstring) was limited, returning to practice for the first time since Week 1.

The same report says DL 'Aaron Donald' missed Wednesday practice with a sore back. Donald retired after 2023, so this name is unverified and may be an error. Overall the Rams listed 9 players and the Eagles listed 14 on their first reports.
The Rams average 6.1 yards per play with Puka Nacua and 5.1 without him. He has not played yet this season.

The Broncos beat the Rams 30-26 on Sunday Night Football on Sept 27, intercepting Matthew Stafford on the final play. Stafford went 30 of 55 for 390 yards with 2 TDs and 2 INTs, one of them a pick-six (his 33rd, an NFL record). Davante Adams had 8 catches for 195 yards and 2 TDs.
Rams results this season: lost 27-7 to the 49ers on Sept 10, beat the Giants 28-6 in Week 2 on Monday night, and lost 30-26 at Denver.
The Eagles beat the Titans 24-20 on Sept 20 in Week 2. They are 2-1, with the only loss 27-7 at Chicago.

Kickoff is Sunday, Oct 4, 2026 at 1:00 p.m. ET on FOX at Lincoln Financial Field. One Rams.com headline calls it Sunday Night Football, so sources disagree on the time slot. The Eagles are on a short week after Monday's game, and the Rams played Sunday night and travel east.

The Eagles have won 4 straight meetings with the Rams, including a win last season that the Inquirer called a 'signature win'. Four games is a small sample, and I could not confirm the count from a primary source.

market.question: Will Iliana Iotova win the next Bulgarian presidential election?
market.rules:
Presidential elections in Bulgaria are expected to be held in the Fall of 2026.

This market will resolve according to the listed candidate who wins the next presidential election in Bulgaria. 

This market includes any potential second round. If the result of this election isn't known by December 31, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, the market will resolve to "Other".

This market will resolve based on the result of the election, as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as reported by the Bulgarian government, specifically the Central Election Commission (Centralna izbiratelna komisia, CEC) (www.cik.bg/).

recent_facts.fact: In a Market Links poll for bTV (1,006 adults, fieldwork Sept 26–29, 2026), the Iotova–Valchev ticket had 41.4% and the Gyurov–Kandev ticket 21.9%. Kostadinov–Volgin (Revival) had 6.4%.
In the same Market Links poll, 20.4% of respondents said they had not yet decided whom to support.

Wikipedia lists the Market Links Sept 26–29 poll with decided voters recalculated to 100%: Iotova 51.6%, Gyurov 27.5%, Kostadinov 8.0%, Mihaylov 4.9%, Vasilev 2.0%. An earlier Global Metrics poll (June 23–July 11, 2026) had Iotova 39.7%, Kostadinov 13.3%, Vasilev 5.5% and Gyurov 4.8%.

Incumbent president Iliana Iotova is running as an independent, backed by Progressive Bulgaria, BSP–United Left, Stand Up.BG and IMRO. Gyurov is running as an independent, supported by the We Continue the Change–Democratic Bulgaria coalition. GERB declined to nominate a candidate.
The first round is on October 25, 2026. If no candidate wins 50% or more, a runoff is held on November 1, 2026, which is after the question closes on October 26.

Under Bulgaria's two-round system, the top two go to a runoff if no candidate gets a majority in the first round, or if a candidate gets a majority but turnout is below 50%. The article states that no candidate has ever won in the first round.
27 candidate pairs are registered, the most in any direct presidential election in Bulgaria. Gyurov is ballot #4 and Iotova is ballot #25.

Gyurov and his running mate Georgi Kandev, former chief secretary of the Interior Ministry, opened their campaign on September 26 at Sofia Event Center. They were nominated by a citizens' initiative committee. The official campaign began on September 25.
Gyurov named Iliana Iotova as his main opponent in the presidential race.
Andrey Gyurov officially announced his presidential candidacy on September 1, 2026. He was caretaker prime minister from February 19 to May 8, 2026.
Market Links reported trust in Iotova about 20 points higher than trust in Gyurov, and also found that trust in Rumen Radev is falling.

recent_facts.fact: UNVERIFIED, from memory: of the sitting presidents who were on the ballot for re-election since 1992, Parvanov (2006) and Radev (2021) won and Stoyanov (2001) lost, so 2 of 3 won. This is a very small sample, and Iotova took office mid-term in January 2026 rather than through an election.

market.question: US announces end of Iranian blockade by October 15, 2026?
market.rules:
On July 13, 2026, Trump announced the United States would reinstate its naval blockade of Iran, targeting Iranian ships and customers.

This market will resolve to “Yes” if the United States government, or an authorized representative of the United States government, publicly and officially announces the end, termination, lifting, or suspension of the United States’ naval blockade on Iranian ships and ships of Iranian customers, between market creation and the specified date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

An announcement qualifies if it communicates that the United States will generally cease blocking vessel traffic for Iranian ships and customers, including an announcement that the blockade will not take effect at all, even if some restrictions remain (for example, an imposition of fees). An announcement does not qualify if it reflects only a limited or partial change that stops short of a general end or suspension of the blockade, for example, an exemption for a specific vessel, cargo, or port.

A qualifying announcement must be a declarative statement of the United States government’s present termination or suspension of the blockade, previously-unannounced prior termination or suspension of the blockade, or definitive decision to terminate or suspend the blockade.

A qualifying announcement must clearly and unambiguously identify the end or suspension of the blockade. Statements that merely allude to, reference, or describe an end to the blockade, without clearly communicating it, do not qualify. The announcement need not use specific terminology or reference the end of a blockade by name; an announcement of a resumption of prior obligations, the maintenance of a status quo, or a return to a previously agreed baseline qualifies, provided the substantive policy of ending or suspending the blockade is clearly and unambiguously communicated.

A qualifying announcement must be made through official channels, by an individual acting in an official capacity. Statements made incidentally or informally in a context not intended for official communication do not qualify.

The following do not qualify:

Anonymous, unattributed, or leaked statements not confirmed as official;
Statements by persons not authorized to speak for the United States government;
Third-party speculation, analysis, or predictions that the United States government will announce or implement an end to the blockade;
Satirical, fabricated, hacked, or impersonated communications; and
Statements that describe a prospective, contingent, probable, or conditional end to the blockade rather than announcing a present and decided position.

Once a qualifying announcement is made, this market will resolve to “Yes” regardless of whether it is later reversed, or whether the blockade actually ends in practice.

Resolution will be based on official information from the United States government, including the President, the Department of Defense, the Department of State, and United States Central Command (CENTCOM), or the official representatives of the United States government.

recent_facts.fact: Undrafted rookie QB Jalon Daniels will make his first NFL start for Tampa Bay against Green Bay. Baker Mayfield dislocated his right thumb and is expected to miss about three weeks. Daniels is the first undrafted rookie QB to start for the Buccaneers in the franchise's history.
Tampa Bay lost 23-16 to Minnesota in Week 3 and fell to 0-3. Mayfield went 17 of 34 for 217 yards with 1 TD and 1 INT before he dislocated his thumb late in the game.
Tampa Bay lost its first two games by one score each: 33-27 at Cincinnati in Week 1 and 23-19 at home to Cleveland in Week 2. All three Bucs losses were decided by 7 points or fewer.

Green Bay lost 35-14 at home to Atlanta on Thursday night in Week 3, which ended the Packers' streak of 13 straight home-opener wins. Atlanta scored 27 straight points to turn an early 0-7 deficit into a 27-7 lead in the fourth quarter. The Packers are 1-2.

The Packers' results so far: in Week 1 they lost to Minnesota by 17 points. In Week 2 they beat the New York Jets in overtime after coming back from a 10-point deficit in the fourth quarter. In Week 3 they lost 35-14 to Atlanta.

Packers DE Micah Parsons (torn ACL and meniscus from last December) is still on the PUP list. His 21-day practice window had not opened, so he must miss at least one more game. RB Josh Jacobs is on the commissioner's exempt list after an offseason arrest and a groin injury in camp.

On Wednesday's Week 4 injury report, these Bucs did not practice: Rueben Bain Jr. (groin/shoulder), Yaya Diaby (calf/shoulder), Chris Godwin Jr. (ankle), Ko Kieft (elbow), Baker Mayfield (thumb), Rakeem Nuñez-Roches (ankle/foot) and Jacob Parrish (personal). Bucky Irving (glute), SirVocea Dennis, Keionte Scott and Josiah Trotter were limited. WR Jalen McMillan went on IR with a knee injury and is out 6–8 weeks.

On Wednesday's report, these Packers did not practice: OL Aaron Banks (knee/toe), Karl Brooks (illness), Anthony Campbell (ankle) and Jacob Monk (quad). Warren Brinson, Edgerrin Cooper and Lukas Van Ness were limited.
Green Bay plays at Tampa Bay on Sunday, Oct 4, 2026 in Week 4, so the Buccaneers have home field. Green Bay comes in 1-2 and Tampa Bay 0-3.

Green Bay's 2025 season ended with five straight losses, the last a 31-27 Wild Card loss to Chicago. Jordan Love is still the starting QB, and the Packers' offensive line has had injuries (Banks, Zach Tom, Elgton Jenkins).
